wiki.title: Scott Lewis (politician)
wiki.extract: Anthony Scott Lewis (born June 2, 1961) is an American politician who has served as a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives since January 2019. He represents Kentucky's 14th House district, which includes Hancock and Ohio counties as well as part of Daviess County. He was first elected in 2018 when incumbent Matt Castlen retired to run for the Kentucky Senate.
